08 Finding your way through the manuscript
A small glossary and reading map
Catalogue
The recorded times, locations and magnitudes of selected earthquakes.
Parameter
An adjustable model setting, such as the strength or duration of an
effect.
Inhibition
A mechanism that reduces a specified part of the modelled event rate.
Identifiability
Whether different settings could be distinguished from the model's
observable law, in principle.
Null control
A simulated case without the effect the procedure is supposed to detect.
Oracle calibration
A simulation-based reference using the known generating law.
Held-out data
Observations outside a particular fitting step; repeated inspection can
still make them part of model development.
Zero-strength
boundary
The setting where inhibition is switched off and its unused range and
memory cannot be identified.
Calibration
Agreement between a forecast's probability statements and repeated
outcomes under the declared comparison.
OC, EP, LI and LI+
OC uses a regional background map to weight where triggered activity is
placed; EP omits that weighting and uses its own distance-decay rule. LI
adds local background suppression to OC; LI+ gives larger events
stronger suppressing weights.
